name: Chip (Android)
summary: Material chips are compact elements: filter chips toggle a filter, input chips represent something the person entered, assist chips offer a smart action, suggestion chips offer a reply.

variants.name: Filter
variants.use: Narrow a list. Toggles on and off.

variants.name: Input
variants.use: Tags the person added. Can be removed.

whenToUse: Filtering, entering tags, and quick suggestions.
whenNotToUse: Status: use a badge or tag.
iOS: use a segmented control or toggle button.

keyboard: Tab to each chip; Enter or Space toggles.
Backspace or Delete removes a focused input chip.
notes: Input chips: remove button has a name (Remove Design).
32dp visible height with a 48dp touch target.

code.html: Design
